sentences.en: This water needs to go to a sewage treatment plant.
sentences.zh: 这水需要送到污水处理厂。

sentences.en: The new housing estate had a strong smell of sewage.
sentences.zh: 新住宅区弥漫着一股刺鼻的污水味。

sentences.en: Excess water went down the drain to the sewage.
sentences.zh: 多余的水通过下水道排入污水系统。

senses.zh: 下水道, 污水。v.用污水灌溉, 装下水道于。
